title: Signed cylinder propagation and marked polygons on the honeycomb lattice
main_claim: At x=(2+sqrt2)^{-1/2} with loop fugacity 2, the balanced-cylinder partition of disjoint polygons separating two opposite marks is G_m(2)=m^{1/6+o(1)}, with |G_m(2cos Theta)| <= m^{Re(1/6-2Theta^2/(3pi^2))+o(1)} and an O(log m) incompatible-pair bound. Consequences: the planar nesting partition is Z(R)=R^{1/12+o(1)}; for first-exit hexagon chords, Z^chord=R^{3/4+o(1)}, the mean length is R^{4/3+o(1)} and the bulk visit probability is R^{-2/3+o(1)}; and the length-squared mass of polygons of diameter <= H is at most H^{2/3+o(1)}.

issues.location: Secs c7-04-boson / c7-05-stability / c7-11-shifted (gas identity, absolute stability, uniform suppression)
issues.description: These sections are too compressed and long for a line-by-line check in this pass. The scalar outputs I could test are all correct: the rates of D_g, D_W/Z_Gamma and c(T), kappa_infinity, c_*/c, and z_M+z_F. The local stability and suppression estimates were not independently re-derived. This is not a located gap.
issues.evidence: Theorem j:absolute-stability, Proposition c7:gas-identity, Proposition j:shifted-suppression are used as black boxes by Secs 6 and 12

issues.description: The paper states tr E_0^n = det(I-A_0^n)^{-1}/c(bn) exactly. c(T) is built from Dedekind-type products, D_ell and powers of T. Those can carry subexponential corrections such as powers of T or e^{c/T}, which a sum of eigenvalue powers cannot contain. So exactness needs those corrections to cancel, and the paper does not show this. It does not affect the results: only lim log c(T)/T = pi/16 is used, and c(bn) cancels in the ratio defining R_m.
issues.evidence: c(T)=sqrt(8/9)/(8 sqrt(2T) D_ell) (sqrt T D_W/Z_Gamma)^2 D_g; 'the Gaussian sum and the powers of T are subexponential'

coverage:
Read in full: introduction, the cylinder-exponent section, the trace-coefficient lemma, the compact-propagation section, the Pfaffian normalization, the localization section, the boundary section from the wedge comparison on (wedge, extremal segments, convex cap, chord partition, visit identity, mean bounds), the marked theorem statement, the marked-gas normalizer and cancellation, the mixed-radius proposition, the unequal-interval proof, and the selected-pair/planar-polygon counting.

Checked numerically or symbolically:
- Normalization: e^{-m^2 kappa}N^2/P0 = m^{5/24} (the m^2 and m terms cancel exactly). kappa_infinity = 2 log(2p0/9), confirmed by quadrature, and the sine product identity also holds. The integral of phi is 5pi^2/144, giving 5/48. The Fourier ratio is (2/3)e^phi. S_d(0)^{-1/2} = 2/3. D_e has total change 3pi/2 = 2nu.
- Exponent assembly: the interval exponent 3/8 - 8theta^2/(3pi^2) gives p* = 1/6 - 2Theta^2/(3pi^2); p*(pi/2) = 0 is consistent with G(0) = 1.
- Pair weights and lower bound: the identity -d2 log G(0) = ordered incompatible pairs holds, and the three-circle lower-bound logic works.
- Localization: the constant (5sqrt2+2) checks, including the reflection, translation and rotation injections and the 60-degree strip-intersection diameter M.
- Wedge and visit identity: the wedge ratio is r = sqrt2, and the cosine constants sqrt2 and 2+sqrt2 are correct, with comparison factor 1/sqrt2.
- Chord exponents: 3/4, 4/3 and -2/3 check.
- Marked charge table: the minimum sum is 9/8, giving u_c = e^{-pi b/4} and the exponent -4/3.
- Rates: c has rate pi/16, c_* has pi/96, and c_*/c has -5pi/96 (determinant rate -19pi/288). The r_X exponent is 1/16 + 1/(pi sqrt3), which is below 1/3 after subtracting 5/24. The winding coefficients cancel (41/12 - 4 + 5/4 - 2/3 = 0).
- Polygon counting: x·2^{6/7} < 1, and greedy windows cover at least N/7 edges. In the selected-pair geometry, sin(theta* - pi/6) = 1/(2sqrt19) and f < 0.6 at tan theta*; the counts, the bounds 3H < M <= 10H/sqrt3, L >= 2 and n >= m all hold. The dyadic sum gives H^{2/3}.

Not verified line by line: the contour, boson and stability sections, the shifted-suppression section, the physical two-bond identity, and the fused-increment derivative-exponent part of the boundary section.

All the exponents also agree with the standard Coulomb-gas predictions for the dilute O(0) model at g=3/2.
sibling_notes: On the family 237 board, five sibling papers reported no_gap_found: Cylinder loop weights, Polynomial vacuum, Renewal, Uniform marked-polygon, and Marked-polygon correlations. They had already verified the same determinant symbols, the 5/24 denominator, the 3/8 saturation and the boundary exponent 3/4. This paper reuses the same constants (5/48, 5/24, 3/8, -4/3) and my independent checks agree with theirs, so the board was consistent background but changed nothing in my verdict.
